paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.82% on average, with Hang Seng strongest (+8.01%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-4.50%). Brent crude changed -15.71% to 96.83. Gold changed +2.57% to 4,135.2002. Bitcoin changed +2.96% to 79,728.0938. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.894%, a relative move of -2.99%. Among the firms tracked, US Oil Fund (ETF) (-12.70%) and Ares Management (+10.52%) moved the most.
